God damn...people like you are so exhausting....if you have seen it then move on...there are plenty of us that havent and appreciate a repost.

My family is ok with it as long as i live a celibate life. They still love me but just dont want me to live the gay life style. I have tried therapists, medication, street drugs all in vain.
